ideas.pitch: An edge-powered automated waste segregation bin that classifies organic, recyclable, and hazardous waste using computer vision and sorts them via microcontrollers.
ideas.title: Smart Campus Waste Sorter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the Best Hardware track directly by featuring an IoT physical build and working directly off the winning pattern of a physical robotics garbage classifier.

ideas.pitch: An offline developer tool that runs code reviews for vulnerabilities locally on hardware NPUs without sending proprietary source code to external servers.
ideas.title: Local NPU Code Security Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the Devfolio sponsor tooling ecosystem and matches the winning architecture of running offline AI models on specialized hardware accelerators.

ideas.pitch: A closed-loop operations dashboard that aggregates IoT smart meter data from college labs and triggers automated diagnostic alerts for abnormal power drains.
ideas.title: Campus Energy Anomaly Watcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines multi-agent workflow concepts with real-world utility tracking, mirroring the exact patterns of the SEAL Hackathon 3rd place winner.

ideas.pitch: A web interface tailored for local water authorities in Kerala to predict algal bloom risks in backwaters using historical sensor data and machine learning.
ideas.title: Water Body Algal Risk Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a localized, highly practical environmental problem with a working predictive interface, matching the formula of the AquaSense IoT Hackathon winner.

ideas.pitch: A mobile-first component library and accessibility testing suite designed specifically for regional government portals in Kerala to ensure high contrast and screen-reader compliance.
ideas.title: Minimalist Accessible Design System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Specifically targets the Best Design track by focusing heavily on UI/UX accessibility standards, clear typography, and a polished user journey.
